author: Pablo
description: A minimal and simple plugin for getting media covers. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.

manifest.author: ionmint
manifest.description: Search for a cover image for the current note and assign it to the note's cover frontmatter property.
manifest.name: Get Covers

name: Get Covers

releases.author: ionmint
releases.description:
# Get Covers 1.0.1

First public fixed release. **Get Covers** finds a cover image for the note you're viewing and writes it to the note's `cover` frontmatter property — running from a single codebase on **Desktop, Android, and iOS**.
